Description.description: A per-user Navigator entry: a captured history row (page/record view), a manual pin, or a bookmark. Owner-scoped for per-user isolation (NFR-03).
Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

Date and time that the record was migrated.

Timestamp of most recent visit/creation; drives ordering and the 30-day prune-on-write retention policy.
Unique identifier for entity instances
entityrecord / entitylist / custom / weblink — the kind of page/target this row represents.
captured / manual — how the row was created.

Normalized GUID (as text) of the target record when sprk_pagetype = entityrecord. Nullable for pages/lists/weblinks. Text, not Uniqueidentifier, because the target entity is polymorphic (varies per row via sprk_targetlogicalname) — same pattern as sprk_todo.sprk_regardingrecordid.
e.g. sprk_matter, custompage. Nullable for raw-URL links (sprk_pagetype = weblink) that have no Dataverse entity target.
history / pin — distinguishes a captured history row from a user-created pin.
Raw URL for manual bookmarks that don't parse to a host entity/page shape (weblink bookmarks); also usable as a fallback deep link.
Optional dedupe/rank counter; incremented on repeat capture of the same target instead of creating a duplicate history row.
